pr_summary: Fix df_to_arrow function in _arrow_types.py to properly handle all-null columns with dtype 'object' or 'category' by casting them to appropriate pandas extension dtypes (StringDtype for object, CategoricalDtype for category) before Arrow conversion, ensuring TileDB attributes are correctly marked as nullable.
candidate_smoke_commands: python -c 'import pandas; import pyarrow; print("Dependencies OK")'
environment_management: pip with setup.py; native library libtiledbsoma required
patch_file_cues: _arrow_types.py: df_to_arrow function modified to handle all-null object and categorical columns
Casting to pd.StringDtype() for object dtype all-null columns
Casting to pd.CategoricalDtype() for category dtype all-null columns
test_file_cues: Test columns: empty_categorical_all, empty_categorical_partial, empty_extension_all, empty_extension_partial
Assertions check obs.attr(...).isnullable for all four column types
notes: This is a Python package (TileDB-SOMA) for single-cell data storage. The fix addresses handling of all-null columns in pandas DataFrames during Arrow conversion. The project requires native libraries (libtiledbsoma, tiledb) which must be pre-installed or built from source. Tests use pytest and require anndata test data files. The platform is Linux-compatible; CI runs on Ubuntu and macOS.
